opportunities.title: Early Career Fellowships

amount.raw: £56,000 in year one, £28,000 in years two and three, up to £6,000 per annum for research expenses

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants must not have held a full‑time permanent academic post, must hold a doctorate, must have submitted their thesis for viva by the closing date, must be UK‑based (degree or academic position) and must not have held extensive post‑doctoral positions.
opportunities.summary: Supports early‑career researchers to undertake a significant piece of publishable research over a three‑year fellowship.

opportunities.title: Art Scholarship Under 18s
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Specialist arts training institutions or registered charities delivering fine and performing arts training for school‑age children (under 18). Institutions only; individual scholars cannot apply.
opportunities.summary: Provides funding for arts training programmes for school‑age children outside regular school hours.

opportunities.title: Art Scholarship Under/Postgraduate

amount.raw: Maximum total award £475,000 per institution; bursaries £5,000‑£10,000 per student per year

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Specialist arts training institutions or charities that award undergraduate/postgraduate degrees in fine and performing arts. Institutions only; individual students cannot apply.
opportunities.summary: Provides bursaries to support outstanding undergraduate or postgraduate students in the fine and performing arts.

opportunities.title: Emeritus Fellowships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Retired or partially retired UK university researchers (or eligible independent research institutes) who have a record of research and are UK residents for at least 26 weeks per year.
opportunities.summary: Supports retired researchers to complete a research project and prepare results for publication.

opportunities.title: Leverhulme Doctoral Scholarships

amount.raw: Ten awards up to £5 million total (approximately £5 million per award round)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK universities with research degree‑awarding powers (or consortia of up to two universities) may apply for up to 30 doctoral scholarships in an interdisciplinary priority area.
opportunities.summary: Provides doctoral scholarships (including master‑plus‑PhD routes) and limited post‑doctoral opportunities to support interdisciplinary research training.

opportunities.title: Leverhulme Research Centres

amount.raw: Up to £10 million for up to 10 years

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK universities with research degree‑awarding powers (single or collaborative centres).
opportunities.summary: Supports the establishment of research centres to undertake outstanding original research with the aim of achieving a step‑change in scholarship.

opportunities.title: Major Research Fellowships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Distinguished researchers in the humanities or social sciences employed by a UK university with research degree‑awarding powers.
opportunities.summary: Provides salary support (and up to £6,000 per year for research expenses) for two‑ or three‑year fellowships to complete original research.

opportunities.title: Research Project Grants – Detailed Applications
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK universities or other higher‑education institutions (and, on a trial basis, UK‑based independent research institutes) may apply. Principal Investigator must be employed by the institution.
opportunities.summary: Supports innovative and original research projects of up to five years, with at least 75 % of the budget allocated to research staff.

opportunities.title: Visiting Professorships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK university (or specialist arts institution) staff must coordinate the visit; the invited professor is overseas. Institutions must approve the award.
opportunities.summary: Funds UK institutions to host eminent overseas senior professors for 3‑12 months to bring novel expertise and enhance skills in under‑represented research areas.

opportunities.title: Research Leadership Awards
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early‑career scholars with a permanent UK university appointment (lecturer level or equivalent) who have at least two years post‑PhD experience and have not previously led a research team.
opportunities.summary: Supports talented early‑career researchers to build and lead a modest research team, developing research leadership over 4‑5 years.
